headline.en: Smooth Geisha flat white from their own roast

traits.en: Owns QS-certified roastery with software-monitored roasting

traits.en: Large windows provide ample light, good for reading or studying

traits.zh: 吧台有至少4个木质高脚凳，另有室外座位
traits.en: At least 4 wooden bar stools plus outdoor seating

focus.zh: 光线好空间大适合自习

linger.zh: 空间大且有高脚凳可久坐

adventure.zh: 自烘豆+特色澳白与创意饮品
